newsitem.title: UK: UK govt accepts Go-Ahead bus undertakings.
newsitem.headline: UK govt accepts Go-Ahead bus undertakings.

text.p: The British government said on Thursday it had accepted undertakings from the Go-Ahead Group Plc to remedy the adverse effects on competition identified by a report on bus services in northeast England.
In August 1995 a Monopolies and Mergers Commission (MMC) report found that the registration of additional services by Go-Ahead in response to a competitor had been against the public interest.
Go-Ahead has given undertakings to remedy the situation following the MMC's recommendations.
These include steps to meet concerns that some of the company's practices were 'predatory' and likely to damage competition in the longer term.
